findings.location: §1 CSS (Stat card block) vs §4 DashboardPage JSX (StatCard rewrite)
findings.summary: Class name conflict: CSS defines pc-stat-card/pc-stat-value/pc-stat-label (prefixed); DashboardPage JSX uses stat-card/stat-val/stat-lbl (unprefixed). The pc-stat-card CSS block becomes dead code after the JSX rewrite.
findings.fix: Add explicit note in §4 that StatCard switches from pc-stat-card system to stat-card system, and either remove the pc-stat-card CSS block from §1 or mark it as intentionally retained for future use.

findings.summary: panelLoading is a single shared boolean. Rapid clicks on two different rows leave B's panel showing the error/empty state when A's promise resolves and sets panelLoading=false before B's data arrives.
findings.fix: Replace panelLoading: boolean with panelLoading: Record<string, boolean> keyed by recordId. Set/clear per-record in the click handler and .finally().

findings.summary: FR-1.4 specifies margin-top: 52px on .main-content. The design uses position: sticky for the nav (in-flow), making margin-top unnecessary and harmful if added. No clarifying note is present.
findings.fix: Add a note in §1 explaining that FR-1.4's margin-top: 52px was written for a fixed-position nav and is superseded by the sticky nav decision. .main-content carries margin-top: 0.

findings.summary: The current index.css legacy alias section references var(--color-blue), var(--color-text-900), var(--color-border-2), etc. — none of which are defined anywhere in the current CSS. This is a live bug causing broken styles on LogDetailPage, RelationshipsPage, RecordEntryForm, and SignatureModal. The design fixes it but does not call it out as a pre-existing defect.
findings.fix: Add a callout before the :root block in §1 warning that --color-* tokens are currently undefined, causing broken legacy alias class rendering. This sets implementer expectations for intermediate state during the CSS rewrite.

findings.summary: Header transformation description does not explicitly instruct removal of the gradient icon box (PenLine icon) inside the old header.
findings.fix: Add explicit instruction: remove the gradient icon <div> (PenLine) and render only plain white text 'Electronic Signature' inside .modal-header.

findings.summary: CSS defines both pc-seg-tabs/pc-seg-tab and tab-bar/tab-btn as identical underline-style tabs. §8 renames pc-seg-tabs to tab-bar in RecordDetailPage, leaving pc-seg-tabs CSS as dead code.
findings.fix: State the choice explicitly: either keep pc-seg-tabs in RecordDetailPage (no rename needed; CSS already converts it to underline style) and remove the redundant tab-bar/tab-btn definition, or rename as planned and remove the pc-seg-tabs CSS block.

findings.summary: Import removal list says 'Remove LayoutDashboard, FileText, ClipboardList, Users, UserCheck, Building2, LogOut' but the summary text says 'Remove imports no longer used: LayoutDashboard, FileText, ClipboardList, Users, UserCheck, Building2.' LogOut is mentioned separately. The two lists should be consistent.
findings.fix: Consolidate into a single list of 7 imports to remove: LayoutDashboard, FileText, ClipboardList, Users, UserCheck, Building2, LogOut.

findings.summary: §6 says 'drt-table → results-table (cosmetic rename)' but the CSS comment says 'JSX pages using drt-table don't need JSX class rename.' These two statements contradict each other for LogDetailPage.
findings.fix: Clarify in §6: no JSX rename required. The .drt-table CSS is updated to the navy-header style. The className in LogDetailPage stays 'drt-table'.
